CARD / MASTER.note: Trim-only export. Same layout, cropped to the trim box.

PRINT / BLEED.note: The artboard the generator lays out on. Supply this to the printer.

cornerNote: Corner rounding is a die-cut specification, not artwork. The background is full-bleed, so no corner is drawn in the SVG.

colour.cmyk: This pipeline does NOT perform colour separation. Final CMYK conversion happens during print-prep against the printer's ICC profile. Treat the RGB values in design-tokens.json as the appearance target, not as CMYK.

fonts: Live text, not outlined. Supply the font files with the artwork, or outline the text during print-prep, per the printer's requirement.
